439864.overview: Legend of Zelda: The Lampshade (also known as Legend of Zelda: The Lampshade of No Real Significance) is a fan-made flash video game originally created for Newgrounds by The Super Flash Bros. The game parodies the Legend of Zelda series, with the gameplay consisting of one lengthy trading sequence, a typical convention in the series. A few other Nintendo characters besides Link are included as NPCs, as well as the creators and other famous video game characters, including flash video creator Legendary Frog, who is also referenced by one item being called the Frog of Legend. Link cannot die or get hurt in this game, and has no sword.

451628.overview: Zombie Society - Dead Detective is a point and click adventure flash game developed by Interactacles and released on February 14, 2017.

451631.overview:
Heres a quick zombie shooter from Jimp and LongAnimals! See how long you can survive against the zombie horde! Submit your highscore to the Newgrounds leaderboard and see how many medals you can earn! New weapons are unlocked at certain levels. 

Kill 1000's of zombies in this fast paced blood soaked run 'n gun shooter!

451636.overview: A mix between RPG and first person shooting. Interesting to try out. Give it a go. Plenty of things to do and quests to accomplish.

451640.overview: In this platform shooter the player guides a lone biobot killing zombies, robots and skeletons that infest the desolate planet Zombotron. Apart from the standard actions (running, jumping and shooting) the game makes use of basic physics, which allow for blowing up obstacles or dropping boxes on enemies. Killed enemies drop ammo and also money, which can be used to buy better weapons (like a grenade launcher or machine gun), ammo or armor. The game offers ten missions and a list of achievements. The game incorporates an in-game tutorial (in a form of hints).

451748.overview: This is a free, bare-bones version of Zuma Deluxe. It retains the same basic gameplay, but offers only four level variants that are continuously played in order, each time getting faster and more complex. The player is given three lives with which they must complete as many levels as possible. Power-ups in this version are limited, there is no story mode, and there is no level select. Advertisements for the Deluxe version of the game are occasionally displayed between levels.

479281.overview: Launched by Digital Chocolate in 2011, Zombie Lane was described on Facebook as a casual simulation and time-management game where players must survive a zombie apocalypse, clean up ruins, and rebuild their shattered neighborhood while trying to reunite with their missing family.
